## What shipped

- `exports/release_identity.py` (new) — `sig.publication-descriptor/2`
  writer + fail-closed validator (every §3.2 field, populated or
  declared-empty); `sig-YYYY-MM-DD.N` labels derived from
  `snapshot.as_of_world` and allocated under `labels.lock` /
  `sig.release-labels/1` (flock + atomic replace; catalog labels keep
  ordinals occupied); `sig-export-<ts>-<key8>` keyed over the
  instants/watermark/commit/environment/replay (NEW-1 fixed); the §3.3
  clock guards (AR-3 monthly day6 00:00Z→day13 12:00Z + daily
  03:00–06:30Z freeze, `--emergency` lift; host-clock remote-`Date`
  ±120 s with a recorded `--skip-host-clock-check`; unparseable/future
  as-of refusal; earlier-day as-of requires `--replay` → Class S;
  `as_of_world ≤ as_of_belief ≤ built_at ≤ now+5m`; emitted-date scan
  with the real-world-field allow-list); SIG-REL-002
  `promotion_refusals` (v1 schema, non-sha commit, dirty tree —
  recorded or live, both refused — unpushed/unverifiable commit,
  `0.0.0`/missing versions, malformed label, earlier `as_of_world`).
- `manifest.py` — `BuildSpec` carries the full snapshot/belief instants,
  `belief_pinned`, `spine_watermark`, `code_commit`, `environment`,
  `replay`, `materialize_run`, `sqitch_head`, `restore_point`;
  `release_id()` mints the keyed export id; `bundle_io` parses v1+v2.
- `spine_export.py` — T0 read exactly once (`generated_at`, injectable);
  future `--as-of` refuses **before** any DB read; sqitch head inside
  the same `REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY` snapshot.
- `release.py` — `build_release` defaults v2 (`--schema-version 1`
  retained); `renderer_revision` required on v1, refused on v2;
  emitted-date scan fail-closed post-emit; `activate()` enforces
  `activated_at ≥ built_at`; `promote()` = the promotion gate on top of
  the same `activate()` path.
- `cli.py` — `build --from-spine` gains `--belief`/`--environment`/
  `--replay`/`--emergency`/`--skip-host-clock-check`/`--host-clock-url`;
  `release promote` + `release label-allocate`.
- `ops/gcp/export.sh` — `SIG_EXPORT_BELIEF`/`_ENVIRONMENT`/`_REPLAY`/
  `_EMERGENCY` propagate into the job args; append-only prefixes
